description: A single admission credential, signed by the organization's issuer key. The record is the organizer's ledger entry; the holder carries the compact signed token (see packages/tickets for the token format). Maps to schema.org Ticket.

serial.description: Per-event index; its bit in the event's status list marks revocation.

holderBinding.description: Hash of the holder's email or holder public key, carried in the token so a scanner can prompt for a name match. Never the raw email.

holderLabel.description: Name shown on the door list, as the buyer entered it.

token.description: The compact signed token encoded in the QR code. Stored so the organizer can re-send it.
